name: A&A Manufacturing
old_description: At A&A Manufacturing, we build and supply the chassis components racers and fabricators trust. Family-owned since 1966 in Spring Lake, Michigan, we manufacture roughly 90% of our parts in-house and source the remainder locally—so you get consistent quality, tight tolerances, and dependable availability from a single, responsive chassis parts supplier.
about:
A&A Manufacturing has operated from Spring Lake, Michigan since its founding in 1966. The family‑owned business began with a simple goal: produce hard‑to‑find chassis tabs, mounts, and hardware domestically so racers and fabricators could focus on building better vehicles.

The company manufactures a range of chassis components for racing and off‑road applications, including suspension mounts, shock mounts, engine and transmission mounts, braking hardware, gussets, fasteners, and heim joints. Roughly 90 % of the catalog is produced in‑house using precision stamping, laser cutting, machining, and fabrication; the balance comes from local partners. A single facility houses both production and a walk‑in showroom, and in‑stock orders can ship same‑day nationwide.

Customers include race teams, hot‑rod builders, off‑road enthusiasts, professional technicians, and fabrication shops — anyone who needs weld‑ready components with consistent fitment. The shop also supports DIY racers and technician shops with custom one‑off or short‑run tabs, brackets, and specialty mounts, offering guidance on material selection and design trade‑offs.

A&A emphasizes domestic manufacturing as a differentiator: controlling materials, tolerances, and finish in its own shop yields repeatable hole sizing, bend accuracy, and weld‑ready edges. Local sourcing for the remaining items allows quick scaling of specialty runs without compromising quality, and the team provides responsive support from people who know the parts because they make them.
